title: EmailSubmission/set onSuccessUpdateEmail: call_id missing '#' prefix
description: submission.rs:400 pushes the Email/set extra invocation with call_id = call_id.to_string(). RFC 8621 §7.5 requires the implicit call's call-id to be '#<call-id-of-EmailSubmission/set>'. The test oracle at integration.rs:1514 also asserts the wrong value ('call2' instead of '#call2'). Fix: format\!('#{call_id}') in submission.rs and update the test oracle.
